description: Export one or more existing Suparse document IDs as JSON into the MCP response, grouped by task in results (task_id, original_file, total_documents_extracted, documents). Use fetch_document_result for a direct single-document read without submitting an export; use download_results for large results, local files, CSV, XLSX, or Google Sheets. This tool only exports JSON and does not unpack ZIP artifacts. On export timeout, retain export_job_id for the export-job tools or replay the identical export with its retained idempotency_key. Does not delete documents; cleanup is explicit through delete_documents.

export_type.description: Defaults to unified. JSON currently has the same task-group shape for original and unified.

idempotency_key.description: Optional UUID idempotency key. Retain this key and replay the identical document IDs, format, export type, and layout if submission confirmation is lost.

wait_timeout_ms.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for an accepted export job to complete; defaults to 60000. This bounds completion waiting, including polling retries, not submission or transfer. Allow enough total time in the MCP client for all phases.

name: fetch_json_results
title: Fetch JSON Results
